assign.title: core/Item+Page: no `at` key, List extends Item, id rules, all data in `data`
assign.outcome:
**Four owner passes, one merge** — [Item](/framework/core/Item/), [List](/framework/core/List/), [Page](/framework/core/Page/), [Task](/framework/core/Task/)

- [x] drop the special `at` key — `get(key)` resolves one name (a property, then a child's id); nesting replaces the path string; a line may be an array of deltas; old `at` lines still replay for one release
- [x] `List extends Item` — a List has an id/title/icon/View/Store now; its own hand-written `set()` is gone, Item's `apply()` covers it
- [x] id rules — unique per sibling list, a held List is reached by its property name, `add` refuses an id that shadows a real property (not a method)
- [x] all values live in `data`; `static fields` builds a real accessor per name; Page/Panel's instance-writing `get_one`/`put` override is gone
- [x] smoke-tested live, headless: [/framework/](/framework/), [/framework/ai/](/framework/ai/), [/framework/ai2/](/framework/ai2/), [Task/live/](/framework/core/Task/live/), [Item/live/](/framework/core/Item/live/) — all render real data

Two real regressions found THIS way (not by reading) and fixed: the field setter's two-arg sugar crashed Page's own single-arg `set(obj)`; `Object.assign(Layout.prototype, {icon:…})`'s shared defaults pattern ran the new accessor on a bare prototype. Full account: [requirements.md](./requirements.md). Design doc, all four passes: [page-item-design.md](/framework/ai/2026-09-30/proposal-flow/page-item-design.md).
